title: Fabricator
move_pattern: Cycles based on minion count. While fewer than 4 minions are alive: randomly alternates between Fabricate and Fabricating Strike. When 4 minions are alive: uses Disintegrate instead.
notes: Fabricator spawns minions to fight alongside it. Fabricate spawns both a defensive minion (Guardbot or Noisebot) and an aggressive minion (Zapbot or Stabbot). Fabricating Strike spawns only an aggressive minion. The Fabricator prioritizes spawning moves while it has fewer than 4 minions, but switches to Disintegrate once at 4 minions. Avoids spawning the same minion type twice in succession.
